_doc: Validation of a theme pack's themes.json (docs/contracts/themes/README.md). file is the parsed JSON, or a string "$raw:<text>" that is the file's exact text. padTo: the file (written as compact JSON) is followed by spaces up to that many bytes. expect is {ok, ids, accents?} (accents: each theme's accent keys in order) or the first error {code, path}.

cases.name: two valid themes
cases.note: a light and a dark theme; ids in file order

cases.name: family may be omitted
cases.note: family is optional (the picker groups by the pack name then)

cases.name: accent order is the file order
cases.note: accents are kept in the order the file writes them, never sorted

cases.name: bad JSON
cases.note: not JSON at all

cases.name: too large
cases.note: more than 262144 bytes, checked before parsing

cases.name: exactly at the size limit
cases.note: 262144 bytes (trailing spaces) is accepted

cases.name: an object at the top
cases.note: the file is an array of themes

cases.name: an empty array
cases.note: at least one theme

cases.name: 65 themes
cases.note: at most 64 themes in one file

cases.name: a theme that is not an object
a repeated member
cases.note: a member written twice in one object is refused (no last-wins)

cases.name: a repeated accent key
cases.note: a repeated member inside accents is refused too

cases.name: an unknown member
cases.note: theme files are strict: a member the contract does not name is refused

cases.name: board in colors
cases.note: the mockup's board is not a token

cases.name: missing scheme
cases.note: required members in the order id, name, scheme, colors, accents, defaultAccent

cases.name: missing id and name
cases.note: the first missing member in that order is named

cases.name: missing colour
cases.note: every one of the 13 colour keys is required

cases.name: bad id: capital letter
cases.note: ids are lower-case words joined by single hyphens

cases.name: bad id: too long
cases.note: at most 64 bytes

cases.name: duplicate id
cases.note: ids are unique within the file; the second one is named

cases.name: empty name
cases.note: 1..64 code points

cases.name: name with surrounding space
cases.note: no leading or trailing white space

cases.name: name of 64 code points
cases.note: counted in code points, not bytes
